title.zh: 【Metaplanet 拟发行约 3.33 亿美元零息可转债，用于还款及回购股票】
title.en: 【Metaplanet 拟发行约 3.33 亿美元零息可转债，用于还款及回购股票】

current_state.zh: Metaplanet is issuing ~$333M of 2031-maturity zero-coupon Euro-yen convertible bonds to repay bitcoin-backed credit and fund share buybacks, explicitly excluding new bitcoin purchases, while its loan-to-BTCNAV ratio of ~17.7% sits above its 10% target.
